ITEM.PTXT: Stainless steel exhaust pipes with excellent heat resistance have been adopted.
Compact ball joint mechanisms have been adopted between the exhaust manifold and front pipe and between the center pipe and tail pipe, reducing booming noise in the vehicle, weight and vibration.

The ball joint mechanism consists of a flange with a spherical surface, and bolts and springs that support the seal portion of the gasket. Compared to a flexible pipe, it can be made more compact and can be installed at the optimum position with respect to vibration.
Vibration and noise are reduced by absorbing vibration from the engine and resonance vibration of the exhaust pipe with the ball joint (spherical portion of the flange and gasket).
